bundle.shortDescription: Costing, inventory, pricing and sales for salon professionals
bundle.longDescription: Salon Resource Manager is a free, offline-first desktop app for independent salon professionals and small salons: work-profile costing, bulk inventory, service recipes, transparent pricing, sales tax, clients, appointments, sales and dashboards.
